about: Shot list for tools/compare_gallery.py. keys: the hook's keys_frames form counted in play frames (frame 0 = play_delay frames after the briefing appears; 0:ENTER*3 dismisses it); frame: the play frame captured; warp: Roman's feet at play frame -10 (game space); crop: fractions of the 3D strip [x0, y0, x1, y1]; before: omitted = the original exe, "preset" = the engine's Original preset (fallback). widescreen: the remaster runs its own follow camera at widescreen_size (no --camera) and the whole 4:3 original frame is shown. original_size per shot overrides the capture size (close-up crops).
